vivian: Heads-up: rolling llm-routing v4.2 at 03:00 UTC. Feature flag = llm_route_v42. Plan: dark-launch 0% (observe) -> 3% (canary) -> 15% -> 60% -> 100%. Hold at each step. We'll pin canary cohorts to model=rv2.4.0 and enable a "drainback" window of 2m before each percent bump. Quiet window requested 02:45-03:30 UTC.

sam: Deploy job db-94567 queued. Request: manual ack required for 15%->60% and for final 100%. No auto-promote past 60%.

kai: Add note: run quick eval set "smoke_prompt_set_v2" against the canary to catch generation regressions before advancing. Also enable short-lived shadow traffic at 100% for 5m to compare outputs.

vivian: Good call. Smoke eval will run at the 3% hold and the 15% hold. Shadow compare enabled at 100% for 5m (read-only).

deploybot: job db-94567 scheduled by @vivian. Steps: dark-launch observe @03:00, set llm_route_v42=3% @03:05 hold audit, set 15% @03:15 hold (manual ack), set 60% @03:35 hold (manual ack), set 100% @04:00 (requires release-leads signoff). Health gates: p95 latency, 5xx rate, generation-quality delta (BLEU-like metric), and model token-rate. Auto-drainback: 2m pre-bump. Auto-fallback: v3-pool for 60s on first anomaly.

sam: Runbook thresholds: p95 > 270ms OR 5xx > 0.8% sustained 3m -> pause and trigger softfallback. Generation-quality degradation > 4 percentage points -> immediate pause and page release-leads.

kai: Can we have quick rollback snippets and unpin commands here so oncall can paste? Also how to run smoke eval manually?

vivian: Rollback/unpin snippets below (ops-safe):

```bash
# emergency abort deploy
deploybot abort db-94567 --reason "rollback: high error or quality regression"
# emergency ff off
redwoodctl flags set llm_route_v42 0 --note "emergency revert"
# backfill traffic to v3 pool immediately
redwoodctl routing force-backend llm-routing v3-pool --duration 120
# unpin canary cohorts from model
redwoodctl runtime unpin --service llm-routing --cohort canary
# pin cohorts to a safe model
redwoodctl runtime set-pin --service llm-routing --model rv2.3.9 --cohorts canary,staged
# run smoke eval locally
redwoodctl eval run --eval smoke_prompt_set_v2 --service llm-routing --cohort canary
```

ops-bot: Manual abort accepted from groups: release-leads, eng-oncall, deploy-admins. Audit trail will show user and command. Do not paste secrets.

sam: Also adding a note: if we revert flag, remember to revoke the model pin separately if we want to unpin. The unpin command is separate to avoid accidental hot-swap.

kai: I'll watch generation-quality, token-rate, and kv-cache miss. If I see sustained quality regression I'll call abort and paste graphs.

vivian: I'm on pager 02:50-04:10 UTC. I'll ack at each holdpoint once smoke eval & telemetry look good. If I don't ack in 6m deploybot will hold and page release-leads.

deploybot: Canary/dark-launch started -> observe-only at 0% and smoke eval running. job=db-94567 step=dark-launch ts=1899991234. Monitoring live.
